paragraphs.en: I dedicate this book to a grown-up for serious reasons. He is my best friend and understands everything, even books about children. He lives in France where he faces hunger and cold; he needs cheering up.
paragraphs.zh: 我将这本书献给一位成年人，原因十分严肃。他既是我的挚友，也深谙世事，即便是关于孩子的书籍也不例外。他住在法国，那里风雪交加、饥寒交迫；我希望通过这书为他带来一丝慰藉。

paragraphs.en: If these reasons are not enough, I dedicate it to the child from whom this grown-up once was. All grown-ups were once children, though few remember it.
paragraphs.zh: 如果这些理由还不足以说明，我将这份献给曾经的我——那个如今已长大的孩子。所有的成年人曾经都是孩子，只是很少有人记得这一点。
